units.source_text: 洞穴的底部，依然什么变化也没有，但他的心情却像登上了高高的塔顶。

en.t: At the bottom of the pit, nothing had changed at all, yet his spirits felt as if he had climbed to the top of a high tower.

units.source_text: 世界变得本末倒置，也许“突起的部分”和“坑洼的部分”倒了过来。

en.t: The world had been turned upside down; perhaps the raised parts and the hollowed parts had traded places.

units.source_text: 沙子里边竟能打出水来。

en.t: Water could actually be drawn out from inside the sand.

units.source_text: 只要有了那个装置，村子里的那些家伙也就很难插手了。

en.t: As long as he had that device, those people in the village would find it hard to interfere.

units.source_text: 就是断了水，也毫不在乎。

en.t: Even if they cut off the water, it would not matter in the least.

units.source_text: 那些家伙将会多么张皇失措呐，只要想到此事，“笑”又涌了上来。

en.t: Just thinking how flustered those people would become made laughter well up in him again.

units.source_text: 尽管身处洞穴，心却早已飞向洞穴之外。

en.t: Though his body was still in the pit, his mind had already flown beyond it.

units.source_text: 回过头来，他环顾了一阵洞穴的全景。

en.t: Turning back, he looked around for a while at the whole view of the pit.

units.source_text: 不隔着一定距离去看“马赛克”，就很难作出判断。

en.t: Unless one viewed the mosaic from a certain distance, it was difficult to make any judgment.

units.source_text: 他郑重其事地把眼睛凑过去看，反而误入了断片之中。

en.t: When he solemnly brought his eyes close to inspect it, he instead lost his way among the fragments.

units.source_text: 即使从一个断片中逃出来，立刻就会被其他断片拽住了脚。

en.t: Even if he escaped from one fragment, another would immediately catch him by the foot.

units.source_text: 仿佛他之前看到的不是沙子，只是单纯的沙颗粒似的。

en.t: It was as though what he had seen before was not sand, but merely individual grains of sand.
